name: Pyromancer: Incinerator reduces target resistance by 30 at level 30 (#660)
contract: #660: Incinerator 807510 is an aura 123 MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE, misc 124 (Fire|Nature|Frost|Shadow|Arcane), base -31+1 = -30 with RealPointsPerLevel -0.5 starting at level 30 (BaseLevel 30), computed natively by SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue (SpellInfo.cpp:474-489). At level 30 the level term is zero so the amount is exactly -30. Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance adds the aura to the victim's resistance (Unit.cpp:2378-2382). Asserts the aura effect amount is -30 once the passive is learned; a non-zero amount proves the specialization passive is applied and scaled natively. The audit report does not verify how the passive is granted, so the scenario learns it explicitly.
